Vigil Hall

Forge Your Warden

Name, likeness and the dice. Your discipline comes later, from its master.
Original keeps the artwork exactly as drawn. Recolor tints it with your skin tone, sigil color and gear.
Every Warden starts as a Beginner on Vigil Hall's island. At Lv 10 a master in Lanternfall's Lamp House takes you on, if you have the stat their discipline asks for.
Every stat starts at 4 and 9 more points fall where the dice send them (4 to 13 each, 25 in all). Roll for the discipline you have in mind: a Warrior needs STR 35 at the Kindling, a Wizard INT 20, a Ranger or Assassin DEX 25, a Gunslinger DEX 20. Each level adds 5 ability points to place yourself.

Key Settings
Drag a function onto a key, or click a function and then click (or press) the key you want. Drag a function off the keyboard, or hit its ×, to clear it. The arrow keys are fixed: ← → walk, ↑ ↓ climb ropes and ladders (↑ grabs one beside you, ↓ drops through a foothold). Jump + ←/→ hops off a rope.
